description: Create a top-up invoice and return a `checkout_url` (crypto checkout page on eqvps.com: USDT/USDC on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche and Solana; BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC, BNB, TRX, XRP, XLM, DOGE, BCH, POL; Monero). The balance is credited automatically once the on-chain payment confirms. `amount` is in account currency (USD); minimum and maximum are enforced server-side. Only one unpaid top-up may exist at a time. Requires: token. A HUMAN must pay checkout_url in crypto; the balance is credited automatically after confirmation.

amount.description: Required. Top-up amount in USD (account currency), number 3–10000, e.g. 25. The checkout shows the crypto amount.

name: topup_balance
title: Top up balance
